```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(knitr)

repository_root <-
  normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/")

while (
  !file.exists(file.path(repository_root, "R", "00_Config_file.R"))
) {
  repository_parent <-
    dirname(repository_root)

  if (
    identical(repository_parent, repository_root)
  ) {
    stop("Could not locate the repository root from the render directory.")
  }

  repository_root <- repository_parent
}

registry <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Manuscript/COMMSENV-25-2408/R1/evidence/claim-evidence-registry.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

reporting_manifest <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/Reporting/evidence__manifest.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

pollen_retention <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/Dataset_summaries/Pollen/pollen__threshold_retention__overall.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) |>
  arrange(.data[["threshold"]])

pap_predictions <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/H1/Temporal/PAP_trends/pap__temporal_predictions.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

hvarpart_profiles <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/Diagnostics/HVarPart/hvarpart__profile_comparison.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

hvarpart_variance <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/Diagnostics/HVarPart/hvarpart__variance_summary__overall.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

spatial_h1 <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/H1/Spatial/SPD/spd__human_climate_balance__dataset_values__time_and_space_control.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

spatial_original_fit <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/Diagnostics/HVarPart/hvarpart__spatial__adjusted_r2_distribution__records.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

temporal_h1 <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/H1/Temporal/HVarPart/spd_events__human_climate_space__zero_truncated_hierarchical_composition__space_control.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

pap_collinearity <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/H1/Spatial/SPD/Predictor_collinearity/spd__pap_collinearity__hvarpart_influence__summary.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

spd_radius_spatial <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/H1/Spatial/SPD/spd__radius_comparison__dataset_paired.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

spd_radius_temporal <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/H1/Temporal/HVarPart/spd__radius_comparison__region_age_paired.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

event_spatial <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/H1/Sensitivity/Human_event_inclusion/events__inclusion_comparison__dataset_matched.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

event_temporal <-
  read_csv(
    file.path(
      repository_root,
      "Outputs/Tables/H1/Sensitivity/Human_event_inclusion/events__inclusion_comparison__region_age_matched.csv"
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(registry) > 0L,
  !anyDuplicated(registry[["artifact_id"]]),
  all(registry[["validation_status"]] == "registered"),
  all(reporting_manifest[["validation_status"]] == "available"),
  all(!is.na(reporting_manifest[["file_hash"]])),
  all(c(
    "scenario", "threshold", "n_records_retained", "n_samples_retained"
  ) %in% names(pollen_retention)),
  all(c(
    "analysis", "variable", "age", "estimate", "n_datasets_marginalised"
  ) %in% names(pap_predictions)),
  identical(sort(unique(pap_predictions[["variable"]])), sort(c(
    "n0", "n1", "n2", "n1_minus_n2", "n2_divided_by_n1",
    "n1_divided_by_n0", "roc", "dcca_axis_1",
    "density_diversity", "density_turnover"
  ))),
  all(c("signed", "zero_truncated", "exclude_negative") %in%
    unique(hvarpart_profiles[["profile"]])),
  all(c("spatial_spd", "temporal_spd") %in%
    unique(hvarpart_profiles[["analysis"]])),
  all(complete.cases(spatial_h1[, c(
    "dataset_id", "total_adjusted_r_squared", "zero_balance"
  )])),
  all(complete.cases(spatial_original_fit[, c(
    "region", "climatezone", "adjusted_r_squared"
  )])),
  any(spd_radius_spatial[["matched_estimable"]]),
  sum(complete.cases(
    spd_radius_spatial[which(spd_radius_spatial[["matched_estimable"]] %in% TRUE), c(
      "zero_balance_250_km", "zero_balance_500_km"
    )]
  )) > 0L,
  any(spd_radius_temporal[["matched_estimable"]]),
  sum(complete.cases(
    spd_radius_temporal[which(spd_radius_temporal[["matched_estimable"]] %in% TRUE), c(
      "zero_allocation_human_250_km", "zero_allocation_human_500_km"
    )]
  )) > 0L
)

preparation_pool_n <-
  pollen_retention |>
  filter(.data[["scenario"]] == "baseline_25_150") |>
  pull(.data[["n_records_retained"]])

original_h1_inventory_n <-
  hvarpart_variance |>
  filter(.data[["analysis"]] == "spatial_spd") |>
  pull(.data[["n_models"]])

spatial_controlled_n <-
  nrow(spatial_h1)

spatial_climate_dominant_n <-
  sum(spatial_h1[["zero_balance"]] < 0)

spatial_climate_dominant_pct <-
  100 * spatial_climate_dominant_n / spatial_controlled_n

spatial_median_adjusted_r2 <-
  median(spatial_h1[["total_adjusted_r_squared"]])

spatial_mean_adjusted_r2_controlled <-
  mean(spatial_h1[["total_adjusted_r_squared"]])

spatial_q1_adjusted_r2_controlled <-
  unname(stats::quantile(
    spatial_h1[["total_adjusted_r_squared"]],
    probs = 0.25
  ))

spatial_q3_adjusted_r2_controlled <-
  unname(stats::quantile(
    spatial_h1[["total_adjusted_r_squared"]],
    probs = 0.75
  ))

spatial_inventory <-
  hvarpart_variance |>
  filter(.data[["analysis"]] == "spatial_spd")

spatial_available_n <-
  spatial_inventory[["n_available"]]

spatial_mean_adjusted_r2 <-
  spatial_inventory[["total_adjusted_r_squared_mean"]]

stopifnot(
  nrow(spatial_original_fit) == spatial_available_n,
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    mean(spatial_original_fit[["adjusted_r_squared"]]),
    spatial_mean_adjusted_r2
  ))
)

spatial_fit_bootstrap_input <-
  bind_rows(
    spatial_original_fit |>
      transmute(
        subset = "original",
        continent = .data[["region"]],
        region = .data[["climatezone"]],
        adjusted_r2 = .data[["adjusted_r_squared"]]
      ),
    spatial_h1 |>
      transmute(
        subset = "controlled",
        continent = .data[["region"]],
        region = .data[["climatezone"]],
        adjusted_r2 = .data[["total_adjusted_r_squared"]]
      )
  ) |>
  group_by(.data[["subset"]], .data[["continent"]], .data[["region"]]) |>
  summarise(
    adjusted_r2_sum = sum(.data[["adjusted_r2"]]),
    n_sequences = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

set.seed(20260918L)

spatial_fit_bootstrap_means <-
  lapply(
    split(spatial_fit_bootstrap_input, spatial_fit_bootstrap_input[["subset"]]),
    function(blocks) {
      block_indices <-
        split(seq_len(nrow(blocks)), blocks[["continent"]])

      replicate(10000L, {
        sampled_indices <-
          unlist(lapply(block_indices, function(indices) {
            indices[sample.int(length(indices), length(indices), replace = TRUE)]
          }), use.names = FALSE)

        sum(blocks[["adjusted_r2_sum"]][sampled_indices]) /
          sum(blocks[["n_sequences"]][sampled_indices])
      })
    }
  )

spatial_original_fit_ci <-
  unname(stats::quantile(
    spatial_fit_bootstrap_means[["original"]], c(0.025, 0.975)
  ))

spatial_controlled_fit_ci <-
  unname(stats::quantile(
    spatial_fit_bootstrap_means[["controlled"]], c(0.025, 0.975)
  ))

temporal_spd_wide <-
  temporal_h1 |>
  filter(.data[["analysis"]] == "temporal_spd") |>
  select(.data[["region"]], .data[["age"]], .data[["predictor"]],
    .data[["allocation"]]) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .data[["predictor"]], values_from = .data[["allocation"]])

temporal_spd_n <-
  nrow(temporal_spd_wide)

temporal_climate_dominant_n <-
  sum(temporal_spd_wide[["climate"]] > temporal_spd_wide[["human"]])

profile_analysis <-
  hvarpart_profiles |>
  filter(.data[["aggregation_level"]] == "analysis")

profile_spatial <-
  profile_analysis |>
  filter(.data[["analysis"]] == "spatial_spd") |>
  select(.data[["profile"]], .data[["predictor"]],
    share = .data[["pooled_allocation"]], .data[["n_models"]])

spatial_signed_climate <-
  profile_spatial |>
  filter(.data[["profile"]] == "signed", .data[["predictor"]] == "climate") |>
  pull(.data[["share"]])

spatial_zero_climate <-
  profile_spatial |>
  filter(.data[["profile"]] == "zero_truncated", .data[["predictor"]] == "climate") |>
  pull(.data[["share"]])

spatial_exclude_climate <-
  profile_spatial |>
  filter(.data[["profile"]] == "exclude_negative", .data[["predictor"]] == "climate") |>
  pull(.data[["share"]])

radius_spatial_n <-
  sum(spd_radius_spatial[["matched_estimable"]], na.rm = TRUE)

radius_spatial_defined_n <-
  sum(!is.na(
    spd_radius_spatial[["zero_balance_delta_500_minus_250"]]
  ))

radius_spatial_reversals <-
  sum(spd_radius_spatial[["zero_ranking_reversal"]], na.rm = TRUE)

radius_spatial_delta_median <-
  median(spd_radius_spatial[["zero_balance_delta_500_minus_250"]], na.rm = TRUE)

radius_spatial_delta_iqr <-
  quantile(
    spd_radius_spatial[["zero_balance_delta_500_minus_250"]],
    c(0.25, 0.75),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

radius_temporal_n <-
  sum(spd_radius_temporal[["matched_estimable"]], na.rm = TRUE)

radius_temporal_reversals <-
  sum(spd_radius_temporal[["zero_ranking_reversal"]], na.rm = TRUE)

radius_temporal_human_delta_median <-
  median(spd_radius_temporal[["zero_allocation_human_delta_500_minus_250"]], na.rm = TRUE)

event_spatial_reference <-
  event_spatial |>
  filter(
    .data[["cohort"]] == "observed_events_only",
    .data[["three_way_estimable"]]
  )

event_temporal_reference <-
  event_temporal |>
  filter(
    .data[["cohort"]] == "observed_events_only",
    .data[["three_way_estimable"]]
  )

event_spatial_n <-
  nrow(event_spatial_reference)

event_spatial_combined_defined_n <-
  sum(!is.na(event_spatial_reference[["zero_balance__spd_events"]]))

event_spatial_events_defined_n <-
  sum(!is.na(event_spatial_reference[["zero_balance__events"]]))

event_temporal_n <-
  nrow(event_temporal_reference)

event_combined_spatial_median <-
  median(event_spatial_reference[["zero_balance__spd_events"]], na.rm = TRUE)

event_only_spatial_median <-
  median(event_spatial_reference[["zero_balance__events"]], na.rm = TRUE)

event_combined_temporal_delta <-
  median(event_temporal_reference[["zero_allocation_human__spd_events_minus_spd"]], na.rm = TRUE)

event_only_temporal_delta <-
  median(event_temporal_reference[["zero_allocation_human__events_minus_spd"]], na.rm = TRUE)

table_pollen_retention <-
  pollen_retention |>
  transmute(
    Profile = .data[["scenario"]],
    `Threshold (grains)` = .data[["threshold"]],
    `Sequences retained` = .data[["n_records_retained"]],
    `Sequences retained (%)` = round(100 * .data[["prop_retained"]], 1),
    `Samples retained` = .data[["n_samples_retained"]],
    `Samples retained (%)` = round(100 * .data[["prop_samples_retained"]], 1)
  )

table_pap_definitions <-
  tibble::tribble(
    ~PAP, ~Definition,
    "N0", "Hill richness: effective number of taxa",
    "N1", "Exponentiated Shannon diversity",
    "N2", "Inverse-Simpson diversity",
    "N1-N2", "Difference between N1 and N2",
    "N2/N1", "Dominance-sensitive evenness",
    "N1/N0", "Richness-sensitive evenness",
    "ROC", "Rate of compositional change",
    "DCCA axis 1", "Primary gradient of compositional change",
    "Density diversity", "Density of diversity change points",
    "Density turnover", "Density of turnover change points"
  )

table_hvarpart_profiles <-
  profile_analysis |>
  filter(.data[["analysis"]] %in% c(
    "spatial_spd", "temporal_spd", "spatial_events", "temporal_events"
  )) |>
  transmute(
    Analysis = .data[["analysis"]],
    Profile = .data[["profile"]],
    Predictor = .data[["predictor"]],
    `Pooled allocation` = round(.data[["pooled_allocation"]], 3),
    `Models included` = .data[["n_models"]]
  )

table_variance <-
  hvarpart_variance |>
  transmute(
    Analysis = .data[["analysis"]],
    `Models considered` = .data[["n_models"]],
    `Available decomposition` = .data[["n_available"]],
    `Mean total adjusted R2` = round(
      .data[["total_adjusted_r_squared_mean"]],
      3
    ),
    `Mean unique human` = round(.data[["unique_human_mean"]], 3),
    `Mean unique climate` = round(.data[["unique_climate_mean"]], 3),
    `Mean shared` = round(.data[["shared_mean"]], 3)
  )

table_pap_collinearity <-
  pap_collinearity |>
  transmute(
    Predictor = .data[["predictor"]],
    `Sequences considered` = .data[["n_datasets"]],
    `Complete paired sequences` = .data[["n_with_complete_pairs"]],
    `Median baseline share` = round(.data[["median_baseline"]], 3),
    `Median reduced share` = round(.data[["median_reduced"]], 3),
    `Median change` = round(.data[["median_delta_ratio"]], 3)
  )

table_radius <-
  tibble::tibble(
    Scale = c("Spatial sequence", "Temporal continental-group–age"),
    `Matched comparisons` = c(radius_spatial_n, radius_temporal_n),
    `Defined primary values` = c(radius_spatial_defined_n, radius_temporal_n),
    `Primary median change` = round(c(
      radius_spatial_delta_median,
      radius_temporal_human_delta_median
    ), 3),
    `Zero-truncated ranking reversals` = c(
      radius_spatial_reversals,
      radius_temporal_reversals
    )
  )

table_event_sensitivity <-
  tibble::tibble(
    Scale = c("Spatial sequence", "Temporal continental-group–age"),
    `Matched comparisons` = c(event_spatial_n, event_temporal_n),
    `Combined values defined` = c(event_spatial_combined_defined_n, event_temporal_n),
    `Event-only values defined` = c(event_spatial_events_defined_n, event_temporal_n),
    `Combined SPD plus events` = round(c(
      event_combined_spatial_median,
      event_combined_temporal_delta
    ), 3),
    `Events only` = round(c(
      event_only_spatial_median,
      event_only_temporal_delta
    ), 3),
    Quantity = c(
      "median zero-truncated human-minus-climate balance",
      "median change in zero-truncated human allocation from SPD-only"
    )
  )
```
